overview.en: Nexus (NXS) is a community utility token on Polygon Mainnet. Fixed supply of 1 billion, verified contracts, no mint. Eligible wallets opt in on the official website nxs1000free.io to claim NXS. Liquidity on QuickSwap.
overview.zh: Nexus (NXS) 是部署在 Polygon 主网的社区实用代币。总量固定 10 亿枚，合约已验证，不可增发。符合条件的钱包可在官网 nxs1000free.io 领取 NXS。流动性在 QuickSwap。
